title: Median order total
statementMd:
Compute the median order total (orders with items), rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `median_total`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Rank totals and pick the middle row(s).
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total FROM order_items oi GROUP BY order_id), r AS (SELECT total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM t) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS median_total FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
